draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.19, the 90th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 6th of 10 at QB. He went 64th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (90th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Brad Johnson. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (2nd percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 2nd in passing yards among the 10 QBs in his class with stats.
